# Condensed delegation regression

The three `how` fixtures use the same before, after, and fork revisions documented in [the arena fixtures](../arena/README.md). They cover upstream's removal of repeated Cursor task arguments and movement of those arguments into a single paragraph, while the Codex port retains native delegation and inherited model defaults.

The reviewed removal requires the exact normalized incoming source hash. A different source cannot reuse that exception. After the reviewed update, ordinary later wording changes remain mergeable.
